messages:
Jamie R: Heads up — edge region us-west-2 pool is short 12x H100s. Vendor flagged 6 units DOA on arrival and 6 held at customs. Need quick decision: pay for air-expedite replacements or ask vendor for loaner GPUs while RMA clears. Impacting Dedicated capacity tomorrow morning.
Nina S: Ugh. Do we have serial reconciliation yet? If DOAs are confirmed we should push loaners immediately. Expedited air will cost ~3x freight.
Procurement Bot: PO status: PO-49821 is open. Vendor quoted expedite delta = $72k for air express (door-to-door) vs loaner credit of $0 (no fee) but requires return condition SLA.
Li (logistics): Quick facts — customs hold reason: missing HS code on AWB, customs requested additional invoice. AWB: 123-987654321. If we provide corrected paperwork today we can clear in 24-36h, otherwise transit backlog adds 4–6 days.
Diego M: We're looking at a ~30% drop in throughput for us-west-2 if we don't get at least 8 GPUs online by EOD tomorrow. Dedicated customers on reserved pools will see throttling. Can we do a mixed approach?
Freight Liaison: Propose split: ask vendor for 8 loaners (immediately ship via trusted courier) + expedite 4 replacements by air. That hedges risk and reduces expedite cost to ~$26k. Vendor okayed loaners if we sign temporary equipment agreement. :thumbsup:
Jamie R: Sounds reasonable. Two asks: (1) procurement to confirm vendor signs temporary loaner SLA, including covered shipping and damage liability, (2) infra to validate we can hot-add loaners to the pool without config churn.
Nina S: On (2) — we have hot-add playbook for dedicated pools. Need a quick tag to avoid accidental autoscale to those nodes; use tag `loaner-temp` and route metric exclusions. I'll push the routing change.
Procurement Bot: Draft SLA snippet for vendor loaners: "loaner-term: 30d; damage-liability: vendor-covered if DOA; shipping: vendor-paid outbound; return window: 10d after RMA completion." Need sign-off from legal.
Li (logistics): I'll reissue corrected paperwork and push to customs today — sending invoice amendment now. If customs clears within 24h, we can cancel the air-expedite for those 6.
Diego M: TL;DR: go loaner-first, expedite only if customs doesn't clear by 18:00 PST. That gives infra time to test and customers time to degrade gracefully.
Jamie R: Agreed. Nina — can you apply `loaner-temp` tag and exclusion rules? Li — ping me after you submit paperwork so procurement can pause the air quote. Procurement Bot — queue SLA to legal with high priority.
Nina S: On it. Will post confirmation when tags are live.
Freight Liaison: I'll coordinate courier for loaners, ETA 18–24h after vendor ack. Sending carrier contact and temporary tracking once vendor confirms. :truck:
Jamie R: Thanks. If anything changes, @channel.
